
arXiv RSS yielded two papers with meaningful signal for RLHF in agentic systems. COMPASS applies MCTS-guided process alignment with safety evaluation for search agents (strong 4-criteria fit). The Planner-Centric RL paper trains a deep-research agent with structured reward signals (3-criteria fit). No Grok social signals were actionable this cycle. PReMISE was considered but deprioritized due to thematic overlap with the already-added rubric normalization paper.

## Suggestions

- [COMPASS: Cognitive MCTS-Guided Process Alignment for Safe Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30838) — MCTS-guided process alignment framework for safe search agents, combining cognitive planning with iterative alignment to improve safety and task success in agentic search settings.
  Section: Research Papers > Safety & Alignment in Agents | Criteria: Applies reward modeling / preference learning in an agentic setting (search agents with process alignment), Goal-directed agent behavior shaped by learned alignment signals, Iterative alignment loop (MCTS-guided process alignment refines agent policy), Empirical outcome (safety evaluation on search agent benchmarks)

- [Planner-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Deep Research with Structure-Aware Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30824) — RL framework for deep-research agents using a planner-centric architecture and structure-aware reward signals to guide multi-step information gathering and synthesis tasks.
  Section: Research Papers > RLHF for Agentic Systems | Criteria: Applies RL with reward modeling in an agentic autonomous setting (deep research agent), Goal-directed agent behavior shaped by structured reward signals, Empirical outcome (task success rate on research benchmarks)
